Note:
1. At the beginning of each meeting, depending on the gravity of the subject matter, there may be an 'Accidental Time'.
2. Matters not included in the schedule but urgently required (e.g., presentation of new bills, submission of committee reports on bills, discussion on motions) may be included in the agenda or removed.
3. If the Honorable Minister requests time for a statement of public importance, it may be provided at the beginning of the meeting, and for a response to Zero Hour/Special Time/Accidental Time, it may be provided after Zero Hour.
4. Time may be provided to the Leader of the Opposition, former Prime Ministers, former Speakers, etc., as per parliamentary practice.
5. Days when the House does not meet are reserved for committee meetings etc. Committee meetings may also be held before or after the House meeting on days when the House meets.
6. Provisions of Chapter 24, 27, and 30 of the Regulations, and other matters as needed, may be included in the agenda.

sections.name: Main Business
sections.summary_en: On October 7, 2085, the House of Representatives meeting included Zero Hour, followed by motions to consider several bills. These included the Payment and Settlement (First Amendment) Bill, 2083, and the Infectious Animal Disease (Control) Bill, 2083. The meeting also saw the presentation of the Citizen Investment Fund (Second Amendment) Bill, 2083.

sections.name: Main Business
sections.summary_en: On October 9, 2085, the meeting featured Zero Hour and Special Time. A motion to consider the Solid Waste Management Bill, 2083, was presented. Additionally, the Free Legal Aid Bill, 2083, was presented.

sections.name: Main Business
sections.summary_en: On October 12, 2085, the House of Representatives meeting included Zero Hour. Several bills were presented, including amendments to laws concerning health workers, reproductive health, and social security. A motion to consider the Objects Replacing Mother's Milk (Sales and Distribution Control) (First Amendment) Bill, 2083, was presented.

sections.summary_en: On October 13, 2085, the meeting included Zero Hour, the presentation of the Diploma Engineer Council Bill, 2083, and the National Defence University Bill, 2083. A motion to consider the Some Nepal Laws Arrangement Bill, 2083, and the Ramraja Prasad Singh Health Science Academy Bill, 2083, was presented.

sections.name: Main Business
sections.summary_en: On October 14, 2085, the meeting included Zero Hour and a motion to send the Mediation (Second Amendment) Bill, 2083, Nepal Law Commission (First Amendment) Bill, 2083, Free Legal Aid Bill, 2083, and Infectious Animal Disease (Control) Bill, 2083 to the relevant committee for clause-wise discussion. Another motion was presented to send the Employee Provident Fund (Tenth Amendment) Bill, 2083, Citizen Investment Fund (Third Amendment) Bill, 2083, and Payment and Settlement (First Amendment) Bill, 2083 to committee.

sections.name: Main Business
sections.summary_en: On October 16, 2085, the meeting included Zero Hour and Special Time. A motion was presented to send multiple bills to the relevant committee for clause-wise discussion. These included bills related to mother's milk replacement, safe motherhood, health worker security, diploma engineers, solid waste management, national defense university, social security, and general law amendments.
